authors: Tiago A. Almeida, José María Gómez Hidalgo, Akbo Yamakami
citation: Almeida, T.A., Gómez Hidalgo, J.M., Yamakami, A. Contributions to the Study of SMS Spam Filtering: New Collection and Results. ACM DocEng 2011.
subset_justification: The UCI SMS Spam Collection is the premier peer-reviewed benchmark for binary spam detection. With 5,572 real-world SMS messages, its moderate sequence lengths (mean ~15-20 words, max ~160 words) and realistic class imbalance (~86.6% Ham, ~13.4% Spam) allow an Encoder-only Transformer trained from scratch to converge reliably within minutes on a free Google Colab T4 GPU, providing clear separation of self-attention quality without GPU memory exhaustion or excessive compute overhead.
